parameters.content:
## Zillow For-Sale, Rent & Sold Listing Extractor

**Actor:** [Zillow For-Sale, Rent & Sold Listing Extractor](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/zillow-for-sale-rent-and-sold-listing-extractor)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/zillow-for-sale-rent-and-sold-listing-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `search` (string)
- `mode` (string, required)
- `maxItems` (integer)
- `endPage` (integer)
- `startUrls` (array)
- `zpids` (array)
- `addresses` (array)
- `priceMin` (integer)
- `priceMax` (integer)
- `bedsMin` (string)
- `bathsMin` (string)
- `sqftMin` (integer)

### Output fields
- `address` (Address)
- `price` (Price)
- `soldPrice` (Sold Price)
- `beds` (Beds)
- `baths` (Baths)
- `sqft` (Sqft)
- `propertyType` (Type)
- `status` (Status)
- `daysOnZillow` (Days)
- `url` (URL)

description: Zillow for-sale, rental and sold listings: runs the Zillow For-Sale, Rent & Sold Listing Extractor Apify Actor, returns address, price, soldPrice, beds, baths and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
